results.title: Chemify Becomes the First Chemistry Hyperscaler with £22 Million in Grants from Scottish Enterprise and the UK Government
results.description: Chemify, the deep-tech pioneer of Chemputation, an end-to-end approach combining AI with robotic synthesis for molecular and materials discovery, has received £22 million ($29.7 million) in grants from Scottish Enterprise and the UK Government. The funding will support a significant expansion of Chemify’s capacity to digitize molecular discovery, synthesis and scale-up through a new, second-generation Chemifarm.
